requirement.statement: The project SHALL migrate the ExtensibleScopedRowType type-system behavior into a TypeScript runtime-type-system capability without changing parser syntax.

case.given: The ExtensibleScopedRowType project contains type-system docs, implementation, and tests
case.when: The migration starts
case.then: The project SHALL create a migration matrix mapping each relevant type-system behavior to TypeScript implementation tasks and tests

case.given: The current parser already supports `:::` source-qualified names
case.when: The type system reads parser output
case.then: The type system SHALL consume existing AST source qualifier data and SHALL NOT redefine parser tokens for source qualification

requirement.statement: The project SHALL provide type model, symbol, scope, environment, diagnostic, and source-qualified name primitives for static type checking.

case.given: A source file declares type-level rows, classes, traits, generics, or effects
case.when: The parser AST is lowered for type checking
case.then: The type system SHALL represent the declarations in a dedicated type AST or equivalent typed intermediate model

case.given: A type reference or member reference uses `source:::name`
case.when: The binder resolves the reference
case.then: The binder SHALL preserve both the source qualifier and the member name for symbol lookup and diagnostics

requirement.statement: The type system SHALL bind and check row types, row member access, row merge, and source-qualified row members.

case.given: Multiple row sources may expose members with the same local name
case.when: Code references a member using `T1:::b` or an equivalent source-qualified form
case.then: The type system SHALL resolve the member against the named source and avoid ambiguous local-member lookup

case.given: A merged row contains multiple unqualified members with the same local name
case.when: Code references that local name without a source qualifier
case.then: The type system SHALL report an ambiguity diagnostic instead of selecting an arbitrary member

requirement.statement: The type system SHALL bind class, trait, member signature, generic type parameter, and generic instantiation semantics compatible with ExtensibleScopedRowType.

case.given: A class or trait declares fields, properties, methods, or operator-style members with type signatures
case.when: The binder processes the declaration
case.then: The type system SHALL make the member signatures available for expression checking and diagnostics

case.given: A row, class, trait, or function declares type parameters
case.when: The declaration is instantiated with type arguments
case.then: The type system SHALL bind type parameters and validate arity and constraints according to the migrated baseline

case.given: A class has multiple base classes with shared ancestors
case.when: The type system computes method resolution order
case.then: The type system SHALL use C3 linearization and SHALL report inconsistent base ordering instead of using ad hoc depth-first order

case.given: Rows or classes contain virtual, override, final, or inherit members
case.when: The type system materializes inherited rows or resolves members
case.then: The type system SHALL enforce override requirements, final override rejection, inherit forwarding, and virtual member pruning compatible with ExtensibleScopedRowType

case.given: A class implements a trait and exposes additional members outside the trait
case.when: A value is projected to the trait
case.then: The type system SHALL allow the projection but SHALL restrict member lookup to the trait view

requirement.statement: The type system SHALL provide static checking for typed effects and handlers on top of the current untyped runtime effect model.

case.given: An effect declaration defines input and output type signatures
case.when: A script performs that effect
case.then: The type system SHALL validate performed arguments and expected result type before runtime execution when type checking is enabled

case.given: A typed effect is performed inside a statically checked scope
case.when: The type system checks available handlers
case.then: The type system SHALL validate that handler signatures cover the performed effect according to the migrated baseline

case.given: A handler is applied to an expression whose residual effect row does not include any handled effects
case.when: The type checker applies the handler
case.then: The checker SHALL report that the handler does not affect the residual effects

case.given: A checked function has a closed effect boundary
case.when: The function body leaves residual effects outside the declared row
case.then: The checker SHALL report the residual effects at the closed boundary

case.given: A source-level function or method returns multiple outputs
case.when: The outputs are consumed by a later checked call
case.then: The checker SHALL preserve and validate the full output stack shape

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL expose opt-in type-check integration while preserving untyped execution as the default behavior.

case.given: A caller evaluates a script with RuntimeInterpreter defaults
case.when: The script contains no explicit type-check request
case.then: The interpreter SHALL execute using the existing untyped runtime behavior

case.given: A caller enables type checking before execution
case.when: The script fails static type checking
case.then: The interpreter SHALL return or throw type diagnostics according to the public API and SHALL NOT execute the invalid script body

case.given: A typed runtime context creates an object from a typed class declaration
case.when: The caller reads or writes declared fields
case.then: The typed runtime context SHALL use addressable typed storage and SHALL reject fields not exposed by the active view

case.given: A typed object is projected to a class or trait view
case.when: The caller reads fields or resolves property accessors
case.then: The typed runtime context SHALL resolve through the projected type view and SHALL reject members outside that view

case.given: A typed runtime object is created with a Kon prototype object
case.when: The prototype contains field defaults and accessors
case.then: The typed runtime context SHALL hydrate declared field defaults and preserve getter/setter lookup compatible with ExtensibleScopedRowType

case.given: A typed object has prototype methods matching typed row members
case.when: The typed runtime context invokes a method directly or through a class/trait projection
case.then: The context SHALL dispatch only methods exposed by the active typed view and SHALL use trait projections to select the top implementation

case.given: A derived typed class declares an `inherit` method and does not provide its own implementation
case.when: The typed runtime invokes that method
case.then: The runtime SHALL forward to the inherited base implementation compatible with ExtensibleScopedRowType

case.given: A typed class exposes same-name methods with different effect row contexts
case.when: The typed runtime context invokes the method inside an active effect scope
case.then: The context SHALL select the compatible contextual member and SHALL report ambiguity when the active scope cannot choose one implementation

case.given: A typed runtime bridge reads and writes values through Kon node APIs
case.when: The caller writes primitive Kon values or unsupported structured values
case.then: The bridge SHALL preserve primitive/object values and SHALL reject unsupported structured values

case.given: A typed class has real base classes
case.when: The typed runtime context creates an instance
case.then: The object SHALL materialize parent storage for real base classes

requirement.statement: The type checker SHALL apply generic function type arguments and typed effect operation signatures when checking source expressions.

case.given: A generic function declares type parameters in its in/out signature
case.when: A checked caller invokes the function with concrete input stack types
case.then: The checker SHALL infer compatible type arguments and substitute concrete output stack types

case.given: A generic function is called with explicit type arguments
case.when: The checker validates the call
case.then: The checker SHALL validate type argument arity and substitute parameters/outputs before stack compatibility checking

case.given: A generic function type parameter cannot be consistently inferred
case.when: The checker validates the call
case.then: The checker SHALL emit a diagnostic instead of falling back to untyped success

case.given: An effect row declares operation member signatures
case.when: Source checks a `perform` expression for that operation
case.then: The checker SHALL validate argument stack shape, output stack shape, and residual effect row using the declared operation signature

case.given: The runtime executes a `perform` expression with active named effect handlers
case.when: The checker has typed operation metadata available
case.then: The typed operation name and runtime effect handler lookup SHALL use the same effect identity boundary

requirement.statement: The typed runtime bridge SHALL expose ExtensibleScopedRowType-compatible script execution and runtime permission behavior without changing default untyped execution.

case.given: A source block contains typed class or trait declarations followed by executable statements
case.when: The caller explicitly uses the typed runtime entrypoint
case.then: The interpreter SHALL bind declarations, create typed objects, and execute slot access, assignment, property access, receiver calls, and projections through the typed runtime bridge

case.given: A typed block contains ordinary RuntimeInterpreter constructs around typed object operations
case.when: The caller explicitly uses the typed runtime entrypoint
case.then: The entrypoint SHALL execute through the full RuntimeInterpreter with a typed runtime context installed instead of through a narrow bespoke evaluator

case.given: A typed class declares a default field using `(field #name = value)` without an explicit type prefix
case.when: The typed runtime binds and executes the class
case.then: The binder SHALL register the field with an `Any` fallback type and the runtime SHALL hydrate the default value

case.given: A caller uses the default RuntimeInterpreter evaluation APIs
case.when: The script contains ordinary untyped object operations
case.then: The interpreter SHALL keep the existing untyped behavior and SHALL NOT install typed dispatch implicitly

case.given: A typed method signature carries an effect row
case.when: The method is invoked outside an active effect scope that permits the row
case.then: The typed runtime context SHALL reject the call before invoking the implementation

case.given: A typed method signature carries an effect row and the active effect scope permits it
case.when: The method is invoked
case.then: The typed runtime context SHALL invoke the selected implementation

case.given: Typed runtime code stores primitive, list, map, function, object, or projected object values
case.when: The value crosses the typed runtime boundary
case.then: The bridge SHALL preserve the value kind explicitly instead of treating every value as opaque `any`

case.given: A Kon value kind is not supported by the typed runtime boundary
case.when: The caller writes it into typed storage
case.then: The bridge SHALL reject it with a clear diagnostic or exception

requirement.statement: The parser or binder SHALL preserve ExtensibleScopedRowType negative behavior for unsupported type syntax forms and SHALL NOT silently register misleading type members.

case.given: A field declaration uses unsupported postfix type annotation syntax
case.when: The source is parsed and lowered for type binding
case.then: The parser or binder SHALL reject it and SHALL NOT silently register a misleading field member

requirement.statement: The type-system core computation SHALL run through an interpreter-backed dispatch boundary while keeping default untyped RuntimeInterpreter behavior unchanged.

case.given: The TypeSystem public API defines rows, generic rows, classes, merged rows, subtyping, and generic instantiations
case.when: The API performs those computations
case.then: The computation SHALL dispatch through a RuntimeInterpreter-backed type computation kernel instead of only using scattered direct host logic

case.given: The interpreter-backed kernel invokes host operations for type computation
case.when: The operation needs to build symbols or compare types
case.then: The kernel SHALL use explicit direct/core implementations internally to avoid recursive host dispatch while preserving an observable interpreter dispatch boundary

case.given: A caller uses ordinary RuntimeInterpreter APIs without type-system computation
case.when: The type computation kernel exists in the project
case.then: The ordinary untyped interpreter SHALL keep its existing runtime behavior

suite.name: Class Body and Access Static Checking

case.given: A class method, constructor, or property accessor body references `self` fields or returns values
case.when: The source is type checked
case.then: The checker SHALL validate the body against the declared typed class view and member signature

case.given: A class member is private, protected, or internal
case.when: External source code accesses the member through slot or receiver-call syntax
case.then: The checker SHALL reject the access instead of treating the member as publicly exposed

case.given: ExtensibleScopedRowType C# covers closed rows, row tails, function effect rows, and field-as-getter requirements
case.when: The TypeScript type system is tested
case.then: The project SHALL keep equivalent focused tests for those subtyping semantics

case.given: Unsupported type syntax or malformed metadata cannot produce a meaningful declaration
case.when: The parser/binder/checker processes the source
case.then: The project SHALL emit a diagnostic or parser rejection and SHALL NOT silently register misleading members

requirement.statement: The typed runtime core SHALL expose ExtensibleScopedRowType-compatible class definition, method body, value metadata, global storage, projection invocation, and runtime access boundary APIs.

case.given: A class is defined with typed row members and method bodies
case.when: The class is registered in the TypeSystem
case.then: The TypeSystem SHALL retain a ClassDefinition containing the ClassTypeSymbol and matching method bodies

case.given: A caller needs the typed runtime class definition
case.when: The caller requests the class by name
case.then: The TypeSystem SHALL expose a RequireClass API returning the stored class definition while preserving RequireClassSymbol

case.given: A typed runtime value wraps primitive, object, or projected object data
case.when: The value crosses the typed runtime boundary
case.then: The value SHALL retain both value kind and the best available TypeSymbol metadata

case.given: A host stores values in the typed runtime context global table
case.when: The host later reads those values
case.then: The context SHALL preserve typed runtime value metadata internally and return the original host value at the API boundary

case.given: A caller has an object and a target projection type name
case.when: The caller invokes a member through the target projection
case.then: The typed runtime context SHALL provide an InvokeWithProjection facade equivalent to Project followed by Invoke

case.given: A typed class exposes public, protected, private, or internal members
case.when: The typed runtime resolves members directly or through class-origin projection
case.then: The runtime SHALL enforce the migrated access modifier rules and keep dedicated tests for private/protected/internal behavior

requirement.statement: The typed runtime core SHALL provide an ExtensibleScopedRowType-compatible execution context with explicit value objects, object row implementations, projection dispatch, effect permission enforcement, globals, and value conversion boundaries.

case.given: A class definition contains typed members and method bodies
case.when: The typed execution context instantiates the class
case.then: The resulting object value SHALL contain field storage, method row implementations, inherit forwarding placeholders, trait forwarding, and real parent storage

case.given: A caller needs a field-only typed object
case.when: The caller uses CreateObject
case.then: The context SHALL create field storage without method row implementations

case.given: A caller projects an object to a class or trait view
case.when: The caller reads/writes fields or invokes methods through that projection
case.then: The context SHALL restrict the operation to the projected view and dispatch class origins or trait top implementations accordingly

case.given: A value crosses the typed execution context boundary
case.when: The value is wrapped or unwrapped
case.then: The context SHALL preserve explicit value kind and TypeSymbol metadata through Value objects

case.given: A function value signature requires effects
case.when: The function is invoked outside an allowed effect scope
case.then: The context SHALL reject the invocation

case.given: A host stores typed values in the execution context global table
case.when: The host reads those values later
case.then: The context SHALL preserve the original Value object and its TypeSymbol metadata

case.given: A caller already uses KonTypedRuntimeContext
case.when: The caller needs C#-style typed execution context behavior
case.then: The runtime context SHALL expose its core execution context and an Instantiate facade without changing CreateObject prototype bridge behavior

requirement.statement: The migrated type system SHALL close remaining ExtensibleScopedRowType API and checker parity gaps for source-level row projection, origin-specific execution operations, value boundaries, helper APIs, and invalid binding behavior.

case.given: A merged row value is projected to one of its source rows
case.when: Subsequent source-level member access targets the projected value
case.then: The checker SHALL allow members in the projected source row and reject members outside that view

case.given: A typed object has duplicate member names from multiple origins
case.when: A caller invokes or reads/writes with an explicit origin
case.then: The typed execution context SHALL expose public origin-specific facade methods equivalent to C# ExecutionContext overloads

case.given: A caller ports C# type-system tests
case.when: The caller creates method bodies or effectful function signatures
case.then: The TS API SHALL provide MethodBuilder.FromLambda and function type effect-row helper overloads

case.given: Values cross the typed runtime/Kon boundary in the TS model
case.when: The values are primitives, object-like values, or unsupported arrays
case.then: The context SHALL round-trip primitives and object-like values while rejecting unsupported arrays

case.given: Type declarations fail to bind
case.when: A caller asks for a typed runtime binding result
case.then: The result SHALL be unsuccessful and SHALL NOT provide an executable context

requirement.statement: The migrated type-system APIs SHALL minimize remaining ExtensibleScopedRowType public API and model-shape friction where it fits the current TypeScript model.

case.given: A caller already has parsed Kon nodes
case.when: The caller binds typed runtime declarations
case.then: KonTypedRuntimeContext SHALL expose a Bind(nodes) facade equivalent to BindSource parsing followed by binding

case.given: A caller ports C# typed ExecutionContext code that passes an explicit origin to Invoke, ReadField, or WriteField
case.when: The caller uses the C# argument order in TypeScript
case.then: The typed execution context SHALL support the origin-aware call form while preserving explicit InvokeOrigin/ReadFieldOrigin/WriteFieldOrigin helpers

case.given: A typed execution context has initialized runtime primitive types
case.when: A caller constructs primitive typed Value objects without passing a TypeSystem
case.then: The value constructors SHALL use the initialized runtime registry while still allowing explicit TypeSystem injection

case.given: A caller inspects row members while porting C# type-system logic
case.when: The caller checks forwarding or effect-context keys
case.then: RowMember SHALL expose ShouldForward and EffectContextKey helpers compatible with ExtensibleScopedRowType

case.given: The current TypeScript project lacks the C# KnNodeBase hierarchy
case.when: A typed runtime object crosses TS Kon model boundaries
case.then: KonTypedObject SHALL expose a dedicated KonTypedObject node type through the existing TypeScript _Type node protocol without forcing a C# inheritance model into TypeScript

requirement.statement: The migrated TypeScript type-system public API SHALL align with ExtensibleScopedRowType C# public API shapes where doing so does not break the current TypeScript runtime bridge semantics.

case.given: A caller defines a class through TypeSystem.DefineClass
case.when: The definition succeeds
case.then: The API SHALL return a ClassDefinition with Type and Methods, matching the C# public API

case.given: Existing TypeScript callers previously read class-symbol fields from DefineClass results
case.when: They read common symbol properties from the returned ClassDefinition
case.then: ClassDefinition SHALL delegate common class-symbol getters such as Name, Rows, and MethodResolutionOrder to its Type

case.given: A caller wants C#-style Value field read and write through KonTypedRuntimeContext
case.when: The caller uses value-level facade methods
case.then: The context SHALL read and write typed Value objects while preserving existing JS-value ReadField and WriteField APIs

case.given: A caller ports C# code that reads EffectHandlerBinding.ImplementationFunctionName
case.when: The caller inspects TypeScript effect handler bindings
case.then: The binding SHALL expose ImplementationFunctionName as an alias for the implementation function name

case.given: Effect handler application or closed-boundary validation fails
case.when: The binding result records diagnostics
case.then: The diagnostic messages SHALL align with the C# public API wording while preserving diagnostic codes

requirement.statement: Kunun type system SHALL model explicitly typed class navigation properties as public property members distinct from fields, methods, and schema relation declarations.

case.given: a class declares an explicitly typed property such as Order.shop with target type Shop
case.when: the source is bound into the Kunun type system
case.then: the class SHALL expose a property member named shop whose type is Shop and whose kind is property rather than field

case.given: a class declares an explicitly typed collection property such as Shop.orders with type List<Order>
case.when: the source is bound
case.then: the property SHALL preserve the collection type reference and target type arguments without converting it to a field or relation primitive

case.given: a typed property carries prefix annotations and declaration metadata
case.when: the property is bound
case.then: the property member SHALL preserve that metadata for downstream profile consumers without core ORM interpretation

case.given: a prop declaration appears in a plain row type, schema, or mixin body
case.when: the source is bound
case.then: the binder SHALL report a stable invalid-member-context diagnostic and SHALL NOT add a property member

case.given: equivalent class fields and properties are declared through Kon source and public type-system builders
case.when: both models are inspected
case.then: their member names, kinds, types, qualifiers, access and metadata SHALL be structurally equivalent

case.given: an existing accessor-only prop uses getter and setter bodies without an explicit property type
case.when: the class is checked and executed
case.then: its current runtime behavior SHALL remain available and it SHALL NOT be silently reclassified as a storage field

case.given: a typed class contains both fields and properties
case.when: field-only construction or projection logic enumerates storage fields
case.then: it SHALL exclude property members

case.given: row or class compatibility compares members with the same name across field, property, method, and spread kinds
case.when: subtyping, slot resolution, inheritance, or override rules are applied
case.then: the type system SHALL apply the documented kind compatibility matrix and SHALL reject ambiguous or cross-kind replacement

case.given: a typed property has getter or setter accessor bodies
case.when: the bodies are type-checked
case.then: the property type SHALL constrain the getter result and setter value parameter

case.given: a typed property declares inline getter or setter bodies without companion get_x, set_x, or same-name method members
case.when: runtime execution reads or writes the property
case.then: execution SHALL invoke the inline accessor directly and SHALL NOT require shadow method members

case.given: a typed property also declares an explicit companion getter or setter method whose result or value-input type is incompatible with the property type
case.when: the class is bound and checked
case.then: the checker SHALL report a stable incompatibility diagnostic and SHALL retain the property type as authority

case.given: a typed property has no getter or setter accessor
case.when: runtime execution attempts to read or write that property
case.then: execution SHALL report a property-specific missing-accessor error and SHALL NOT fall back to field storage

case.given: a typed property flows through inheritance, trait forwarding, effective access, generic substitution, or member copy operations
case.when: the resulting row member is inspected
case.then: its property kind, metadata, access, qualifier and effect context SHALL remain intact
